Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:193509
Court No. - 66

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 32591 of 2024
Applicant :- Pramod Kumar

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Sanjay Kumar Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Sushil Dubey
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Sanjay Kumar Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Anil Chaturvedi, learned Advocate holding brief of Sri Sushil Dubey, learned counsel for the informant and Sri Shatruhan Yadav, learned AGA for the State-respondent.
2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
190 of 2024, under Sections 304B, 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Bewar,
District Mainpuri, during pendency of the trial in the court below.
3.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is father-in-law of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, he has been made accused in the present case alongwith other family members including his son i.e. husband of the deceased.

4. He further submitted that admittedly deceased died due to hanging in her paternal home and this fact suggests that when she hanged herself in her paternal home then on the basis of false allegations of demand of dowry, FIR of the present case was lodged.

sentences.text:
5. He further submitted that actually deceased was having suspicion that her husband i.e. son of the applicant was having relationship with one Jyoti and only due to this reason in her paternal home,
she committed suicide by hanging herself.
He further submitted that the name of Jyoti has also been disclosed by the informant even in the FIR of the present case.
6. He further submitted that post mortem report of the deceased also suggests that she died due to hanging.
7. He further submits that mother-in-law of the deceased has already been released on bail by this Court vide order dated 23.10.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 38705 of 2024.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 38705 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 8. He further submitted that there is no specific allegation against the applicant and he is having no criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 31.7.2024.

9. Per contra, learned AGA as well as learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that daughter-in-law of the applicant died within two years of her marriage under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry.

10. They further submitted that before her death when deceased was in her matrimonial home, she made a complaint about her torture on police help line No. 112 and this fact is evident from page 59-60 of the paper book but could not dispute the fact that applicant is father-in-law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against her and deceased died due to hanging in her paternal home and mother-in-law has been enlarged on bail.
11. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

12. Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for both the sides and the fact that applicant is father-in-law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against him and admittedly deceased died in her paternal home due to ante mortem hanging and mother-in-law of the deceased has already been released on bail by this Court and in the present matter, applicant is in jail since July, 2024, in my view, applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
13. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

14. Let the applicant- Pramod Kumar, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade her from Pramod Kumar vs State Of U.P. on 10 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26624239/
2 disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
15.

sentences.text: In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

16. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
